_note: Sentences asserting an analysis, bound to the script that performs it and the output it produces. A numeric check cannot ask whether a described analysis exists; this can. Binding is by `anchor`, a substring occurring exactly once in the document, never by `para`: rewriting the abstract on 2026-09-02 shifted every later paragraph by two and left all six `para` values pointing at the wrong text, silently. `para` is a reading aid only. An anchor hitting zero blocks (the sentence was reworded) or more than one (not distinctive enough) fails tests/test_analysis_claims.py.
